translationRepairs: On the day guiyou, the Wang heir apparent was established as Crown Prince.
On the day guiyou, the domain heir apparent was established as Crown Prince.
In 立王太子為皇太子, 王太子 is the Song domain heir being elevated to imperial Crown Prince, not an heir surnamed Wang; the proposed 'domain heir apparent' correctly removes the false surname reading.
The Prince of Luling, Yizhen, was made Governor of Yang Province; Secretariat Director and General Who Stabilizes the Army Xu Xianzhi was made Secretariat Director and Governor of Yang Province.

The Prince of Luling, Yizhen, Governor of Yang Province, was made Minister over the Masses; Secretariat Director and General Who Stabilizes the Army Xu Xianzhi was made Director of the Secretariat and Governor of Yang Province.

以揚州刺史廬陵王義真為司徒 names Yizhen's prior office as Yang Province Governor and his new office as Minister over the Masses (司徒); the before English wrongly makes him Governor of Yang, while the after restores both appointments and Xu Xianzhi's receipt of 揚州刺史.
The late Minister of Works Dao Gui was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Linchuan.
The late Minister over the Masses Dao Gui was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Linchuan.
追封司徒道規為臨川王 uses 司徒 (Minister over the Masses), not 司空 (Minister of Works); the adjacent 司空道憐 in s0046 shows the text distinguishes the two offices, so the proposed office title is required.

In the fifth month, the emperor was gravely ill and summoned the Crown Prince to admonish him: "Tan Daoji has capacity and plan, but no far-reaching aim; he is not like your brother Shao, who has a spirit hard to control.

In the fifth month, the emperor was gravely ill and summoned the Crown Prince to admonish him: "Tan Daoji has capacity and plan, but no far-reaching aim; he is not like his elder brother Shao, who has a spirit hard to control.

In the emperor's speech about 檀道濟, 非如兄韶 identifies Shao as Daoji's elder brother (兄韶), not as the Crown Prince's brother; 'your brother Shao' invents the wrong kinship referent, and 'his elder brother Shao' restores it.

In the fourth month of summer, on the day yihai, the Duke of Chouchi, Yang Sheng, was enfeoffed as Prince of Wudu; General Who Pacifies the South Yang Fu was advanced to General Who Pacifies the South.

In the fourth month of summer, on the day yihai, the Duke of Chouchi, Yang Sheng, was enfeoffed as Prince of Wudu; General Who Pacifies the South Yang Fu was advanced to General Who Settles the South.

平南將軍楊撫進號安南將軍 advances Yang Fu from 平南 to the distinct title 安南; rendering both as 'General Who Pacifies the South' erases the promotion, and 'General Who Settles the South' for 安南 preserves the change.

On the day dingwei, Minister of Works Prince of Luling Yizhen was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Commissioner with the Golden Grandee's insignia and ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes, and Governor of South Yu Province.

On the day dingwei, the Minister over the Masses, Prince of Luling Yizhen, was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Commissioner with the Golden Grandee's insignia and ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes, and Governor of South Yu Province.

以司徒廬陵王義真為車騎將軍… uses 司徒 as Yizhen's prior office; Minister of Works would be 司空. Commas are needed around the office and noble title so the English does not create the false compound title 'Masses Prince.'
